description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of characteristics associated with a nondeterministic polynomial-time problem challenge benchmark for large language models. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different characteristic: “Uncrushable” (blue), “Complexity” (yellow), “Instance” (light blue), “Scalable Oversight” (red), “Coverage” (green), and “General” (orange). The slices are not labeled with percentages, but visually appear to vary in size. A legend is present, associating each color with its corresponding characteristic. Each slice also contains a small icon representing the characteristic. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, with “Uncrushable” at the top left and “General” at the bottom right. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
